ApplicationUpdate.title: ApplicationUpdate
ApplicationUpdate.description:
PATCH /jobs/{job_id}/application. Requires expected_row_version. Milestone dates are editable.
Each changed field is recorded as a 'field_changed' timeline event.

Availability.title: Availability
Availability.description: Employer-side availability. System-owned; NEVER derived from or written to application status.

BoardMoveRequest.title: BoardMoveRequest
BoardMoveRequest.description:
PATCH /applications/{id}/position — drag on the Kanban. Changes status (if column differs)
and position atomically. Position is between the neighbours' positions (fractional index).

CaptureRequest.title: CaptureRequest
CaptureRequest.description: Payload sent by the "Save to JobWatch" bookmarklet from the page the user is viewing.

CompanyUpdate.title: CompanyUpdate
CompanyUpdate.description: PATCH semantics: only provided fields change.

DashboardSummary.title: DashboardSummary
DashboardSummary.description: Counts honour the location scope (in-scope + unknown) unless noted.

DatePrecision.title: DatePrecision
DatePrecision.description:
How trustworthy jobs.posted_at is.

exact/day  -> absolute date published by the source (preserved, never overwritten by an estimate)
approximate -> derived from relative text such as "Posted 3 Days Ago"
unknown    -> no posting date (posted_at is NULL)

JobSalaryView.title: JobSalaryView
JobSalaryView.description:
Rendered as two visually distinct blocks in the UI. Never mixed.

employer_provided -> "Employer-provided compensation"
estimates         -> "Estimated company salary based on external salary data" (incl. user-entered)

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description: Editable fields. Only manual/capture jobs allow content edits; scope override applies to all.

ManualJobCreate.title: ManualJobCreate
ManualJobCreate.description: Manual entry. Company is matched by id, or by name/alias (created unmonitored if unknown).

MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest
MergeRequest.description:
Merge `other_job_id` INTO the path job. Postings move; the other job becomes a tombstone.
Application data: the survivor keeps its status unless `take_status_from_other` is true; notes,
contacts, interviews, reminders and timeline events of the other job are re-parented.

SalarySummary.title: SalarySummary
SalarySummary.description: Compact form for list rows. `provenance` decides the label/badge.

ScopeMatch.title: ScopeMatch
ScopeMatch.description: Result of the single LocationScope policy (default: India).

StatusChangeRequest.title: StatusChangeRequest
StatusChangeRequest.description: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/status. Idempotent: setting the current status again is a no-op (200).

TrackerRow.title: TrackerRow
TrackerRow.description: GET /applications — the tracker table (jobs whose status category is beyond 'inbox').

UserSalaryCreate.title: UserSalaryCreate
UserSalaryCreate.description: A figure the user looked up themselves (e.g. on AmbitionBox) — stored as user_entered.
